nina: quick sync: onboarding OrbitonX variant (vendor->rdl convert). seeing steady BLEU/LM drop on long-form tasks after quant/sample. Suspect vocab mapping + rotary phase semantics mismatch. reproducible notes below.

raj: can you paste the converter flags you used? and whether you preserved metadata json?

nina: convert command: `./tools/convert.py --in orbitonx.ckpt --out rdl/orbitonx.pt --src-vocab v1.json --dst-vocab rdl_vocab.json --keep-meta false`
Converter output: `mapped=50200 unmapped=18 remapped_ranges=2 token_shift_regions=[(200,999,+2)]`

clare: that "remapped_ranges" smells like our range-collapsing heuristic. We used to patch contiguous unmapped spans by shifting the later ids down. That can shift kv-cache indices.

nina: verified: short prompt (64) logits cosine(fp16 vendor, fp16 converted) = 0.997. long prompt (2048) generation divergence increases; vendor vs converted top-1 match drops from 94%->78%.

dino: did you check whether token ids used in kv cache key are the dst ids or preserved src ids? If they used src ids in residual positional generation, a shift would poison cache retrieval.

nina: kv keys printed: vendor key for token 210 -> 0xdeadbeef, converted token 210 -> 0xdeadbeef as well, but converted token 210 corresponds to a different surface token (because of earlier shift). So cache lookup semantically matches wrong token.

raj: ok so fix path A: change converter to map unmapped tokens to nearest BPE id (no range shifts) and emit an id-mapping table json into model.meta so loader can translate histories. Path B: keep current behavior but teach loader to translate kv cache keys on the fly. Which is lower risk for hosted?

clare: Path A is cleaner (one-time conversion fix) but touches conversion output for all models. Path B requires loader compatibility and extra runtime cost. I prefer A + migration note.

nina: implemented quick patch: `--remap-strategy nearest` -> unmapped tokens collapse to nearest existing ids. Re-ran smoke: long prompt match improved by ~11% perplexity. But still see quality gap under INT4.

dino: what's your quant recipe?

nina: `tools/quant.py --model rdl/orbitonx.pt --bits 4 --perchannel true --blocksize 64 --calib-samples 5000 --sym false`
INT4 baseline: top-1 match 58%. If I add symmetric quant & per-row bias-correction on proj matrices, match goes to 72%.

raj: bias-correction for rotary projections? interesting. How are you applying it?

nina: we detect attention proj weight means per-row and add small bias delta to dequantized outputs to compensate (simple linear correction during quant). It helps rotary-related ops a lot because phase offsets amplify small bias.

clare: also check rotary phase parameterization: vendor stores "theta_base" + per-head scale factors; our loader only applied theta_base. That causes headwise phase drift. Adding per-head multiplier restored short prompt parity (cosine >0.998) but INT4 still lagged.

nina: eval-bot: quick snapshot (short/long prompt suites):
- vendor fp16: lm-ppl(512)=17.9, summarize-bleu=34.2
- converted fp16: lm-ppl(512)=18.6, summarize-bleu=33.0
- converted int4 (no bias-corr): lm-ppl=24.1, summarize-bleu=27.8
- converted int4 (sym quant + bias-corr + per-head-rotary): lm-ppl=19.8, summarize-bleu=32.1

ci-bot: CI job 9901 started: regen-evals + unit-tests on convert/quant changes.

raj: actionable list: 1) land converter remap-strategy=nearest by default + emit id_map.json (PR ready needs tests). 2) extend loader to read id_map.json and assert no runtime shifts (safety). 3) add per-head-rotary import to loader + unit test for headwise params. 4) add INT4 bias-correction step in quant pipeline with a small calibration sweep. 5) add smoke test: deterministic prompt, compare first-64 logits vendor vs converted fp16 cosine>0.995 and converted int4 within tol when bias-corr enabled.

clare: I'll own the smoke test harness. dino take quant bias-corr implementation?

dino: will prototype in `tools/quant_bias.py` and run sweeps over clip thresholds. will post results.

nina: for rollout, let's canary on a dedicated reserved pool (non-default) and gate catalog entry on lm-ppl delta < +1.0 and BLEU delta < 1.5.

raj: agree. also add a brief note in the model metadata: "converted_from_vendor: orbitonx_v1, conversion_date, remap_strategy, quant_recipe" so we can track regressions.

nina: thanks. will open PRs and link here. short-term patch: if you need to repro locally:```bash
git checkout nina/orbitonx-remap
python tools/convert.py --in orbitonx.ckpt --out rdl/orbitonx_remap.pt --src-vocab v1.json --dst-vocab rdl_vocab.json --remap-strategy nearest
python tools/quant.py --model rdl/orbitonx_remap.pt --bits 4 --perchannel true --sym true --bias-corr true
python -c "from rdl.tools import load_model; m=load_model('rdl/orbitonx_remap.pt'); print(m.generate('The experiment showed', max_new_tokens=50))"
```

clare: thanks all. post PR links and CI diffs when available. :thumbsup:
